plain_explanation: A tool has a name, expected arguments and a bounded operation. A workflow follows fixed code paths. An agent may choose its next step, but permissions and argument validation still belong to the application. Read-only calculations and record changes require different controls.
worked_example: An eligible expense of 55 with a cap of 40 gives min(55,40)=40. Negative or nonfinite amounts are invalid. A separate mock request to change a payroll record must remain blocked until a trusted manager approval is recorded.

exam.question: What distinguishes a workflow from an agent?
exam.model_answer: A workflow follows predefined steps; an agent can select subsequent actions within allowed boundaries.

exam.question: Calculate a reimbursement with eligible expense 55 and cap 40.
exam.model_answer: min(55,40)=40. Eligibility must already be established; the calculator does not decide it.

exam.question: A model says approved. Is this enough to write a record?
exam.model_answer: No. A trusted approval check must authorize the specific action and arguments.
